# Legacy backups

Generated by `make oracle` from the legacy app (do not edit). Both contain the demo data plus
dup-versions/v1_jan-feb.csv and dup-versions/v2_jan-mar.csv (same layout as the demo), two groups, budgets, an opening balance, one `dupPick` and one `dupKeep`
override, an investment portfolio and two chats.

* `backup-plain.json` — unencrypted.
* `backup-locked.json` — passphrase lock on; passphrase `oracle-test-passphrase` (test-only).

They drive the legacy-migration tests (Phase 14).
